intro.h2: Showers and Bathrooms Built With Care
paragraphs: S&M Customs handles bathroom remodeling in Brighton, TN and nearby, and shower work is what their Google photos show most: marble-look walls, black hex tile floors, recessed niches, built-in benches and matte black fixtures.

What reviewers bring up again and again is how Matt and Heather run a job. Cathy T. hired them for one bathroom and was so pleased she added a second. Carol B. says they show up every day until the job is done and clean up every day too. Cathy also noticed how carefully Matt protected her carpets and wood floors while the work was going on.

services.h2: Bathroom Remodeling and More in Brighton, TN

items.name: Walk-in tile showers
items.blurb: Curbed and walk-in showers tiled floor to ceiling, with recessed niches, built-in benches, hex tile floors and new handheld or rain fixtures. Several of the finished showers in their photos replaced an old tub or a dated stall.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with large white marble-look wall tile, a high window, a recessed niche and a black hexagon tile floor

items.name: Full bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Whole bathrooms taken back and rebuilt: new vanity and tops, lighting, mirrors, floor tile, paint and trim. One homeowner started with a single bathroom renovation and extended the contract to include a second one after seeing the first.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom with a navy double-door vanity, white top, arched black mirrors, cage light fixture and gray tile floor

items.name: Tub and shower combinations
items.blurb: For families who need to keep a tub, they tile a new surround above a fresh tub, add a niche and finish it with a contrasting stripe. The example below sits under a sloped ceiling, which takes careful tile layout.

image.alt: Tub and shower combination with white subway tile, a black accent stripe, recessed niche and sloped ceiling

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Kitchen updates as well as baths. A reviewer had her mom's Midtown kitchen and bathroom renovated together and called the results beautiful. Their Facebook profile photo shows white shaker cabinets, black counters and a white subway tile backsplash.

image.alt: Kitchen with white shaker cabinets, black countertops, white subway tile backsplash and a stainless drawer dishwasher

items.name: Handyman, windows and repairs
items.blurb: S&M started as a handyman, painting, remodeling and repair service, and still takes on smaller jobs. Past work includes a living room window replacement, a screen porch closed in with new windows and a door, and a deck sanded down and restained.

image.alt: New wood patio cover with square posts and rafters over a concrete patio behind a brick house

why_choose_us.h2: Why Brighton Homeowners Hire S&M Again

items.title: Your floors stay protected
items.text: Cathy T. wrote that Matt took great care safeguarding her carpets and wood floors while keeping the house clean. Carol B. says the crew cleans up every day.

items.title: They show up until it is done
items.text: Carol B. says Matt and his team show up every day until the job is done. Sarah L. called Matt and Heather dependable, consistent and meticulous.

items.title: Clear, fair pricing
items.text: Cathy T. described their pricing as equitable and transparent, with clear communication throughout the project. Estimates are free, as S&M says on its Facebook page.

items.title: Customers come back
items.text: One bathroom became two for Cathy T. Carol B. has used them a few times. Sarah L.'s family had a kitchen, bathroom and window done by the same team.

about.text: S&M Customs (Home Solutions) is run by Matt and Heather from Brighton, Tennessee. The business began as a handyman, painting, remodeling and repair service, and today its Google profile is listed as a bathroom remodeler with a 5.0 rating from 17 reviews. Matt leads the work on site, and reviewers name both Matt and Heather when they talk about the quality and the communication. Customers describe them as polite, hardworking and responsible, and several say they would hire them again without a second thought.

image.alt: Glass-enclosed shower with white subway tile, white hex floor, black hardware and a recessed niche beside open wood shelves

steps.title: Free estimate
steps.text: Call Matt at (901) 315-4970. Estimates are free, and no job is too small or too big to ask about.

steps.title: Clear pricing
steps.text: You get a price for the work agreed. Reviewers describe the pricing as equitable and transparent, with clear communication.

steps.title: Protect the house
steps.text: Before demolition, carpets and wood floors along the work path are protected, something a reviewer specifically praised.

steps.title: Daily work and clean up
steps.text: The crew shows up every day until the job is finished and cleans up at the end of each day.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: You walk through the finished bathroom together and point out anything you want looked at before the job is closed.

items.name: Cathy T.
items.text: We are exceedingly pleased with the exceptional work completed by S&M. The professionalism and quality of Matt and Heather's craftsmanship are truly commendable. Their pricing is equitable and transparent, and communication throughout the project was consistently clear. Matt demonstrated great care in safeguarding carpets and wood floors while maintaining cleanliness. Initially hired for one bathroom renovation, we were so impressed that we extended the contract to include another. Without hesitation, we will engage their services again in the future.

items.name: Carol B.
items.text: Matt and his team do a fantastic job.  Meticulous, hard working, polite and responsible.  They show up every day until the job is done. Clean up every day, too. I cannot praise them enough. Have used them a few times and will definitely use again.

items.name: Sarah L.
items.text: Matt and Heather recently renovated my mom's Midtown kitchen and bathroom. The results are beautiful. Matt also replaced a living room window. Matt and Heather were dependable, consistent, and meticulous in their work. I would enthusiastically recommend this company.

service_area.text: S&M Customs is based at 1287 Nelson Dr in Brighton, Tennessee. The business was earlier listed in Bartlett, and reviews include a kitchen and bathroom renovation in Midtown. If you are in or around Brighton and are not sure whether your home is in range, call Matt and ask. A short phone call is the quickest way to find out.

items.a: Yes. S&M Customs advertises free estimates on its Facebook page, along with the line no job too small or big. Call Matt at (901) 315-4970 Monday to Friday from 7 AM to 6 PM, or Saturday from 9 AM to 4 PM, to set up a time.

Bathrooms are the main focus, from tiled walk-in showers to full remodels. They also renovate kitchens, replace windows and doors, close in screen porches, build patio covers and take on handyman, painting and repair jobs. Ask about your project when you call for an estimate.

items.q: Will my house be a mess during the remodel?
items.a: Reviewers say no. One customer wrote that Matt took great care safeguarding her carpets and wood floors while keeping things clean. Another said the crew cleans up every day. You can ask Matt how they will protect your floors when he comes out to look at the job.

items.q: Where are you located and what are your hours?
items.a: The business is at 1287 Nelson Dr, Brighton, TN 38011. Hours are Monday to Friday 7 AM to 6 PM and Saturday 9 AM to 4 PM. They are closed on Sunday. Calling ahead is the best way to reach Matt, since much of the day is spent on job sites.

items.q: Can you redo more than one bathroom?
items.a: Yes. One homeowner hired S&M for one bathroom renovation, was so impressed that the contract was extended to a second bathroom, and the owners replied that both bathrooms turned out great. Ask for both rooms to be priced at the estimate so you can plan the work together.

final_cta.text: Call Matt for a free estimate on your shower, bathroom or kitchen in Brighton and nearby.
